name: wds_vtab-dsprites_label_y_position
description: A synthetic visual benchmark derived from the dSprites dataset that measures model performance on predicting the vertical (y) position of objects. It is typically used as a probe of learned visual representations and positional sensitivity. The task is low-level and diagnostic, intended for evaluating representation learning and transfer performance rather than real-world generalization.
reputation: A small, synthetic VTAB-style probe used in representation learning research; modest but recognized adoption within the vision research community.
